newsitem.title: GERMANY: Commerzbank profit certificate priced at 98.30. [CORRECTED]
newsitem.headline: Commerzbank profit certificate priced at 98.30. [CORRECTED]

text.p: (Corrects the headline and the text from dividend certificates to profit certificates.)
Germany's Commerzbank AG said on Thursday that its offering of profit-sharing certificates would be priced at 98.30 percent.
The offering, which was announced on September 5, will offer a yield of 7.84 percent and would be 155 basis points above the yield on 6.25 percent German government debt.
Commerzbank said the certificates will have a payout yield of 7.9 percent and 500 million marks worth will be offered through September 19.
